work.title: Untitled (Heart and CD)
work.description: Loose ink line drawing on a pale ground depicts fragmented figural forms including a face with eyes, elongated limbs, and a large heart shape in the lower register. One iridescent compact disc is affixed to the upper right quadrant, its reflective surface contrasting with the monochromatic gestural linework.
work.composition: vertical figural drawing with embedded disc
